connect.lead: Your wallet address becomes your identity in ODP. Your profile ID stays linked to this wallet. Make sure you have a backup of your key before continuing.
connect.btnDesc: Browser extension — MetaMask, Rabby, Brave Wallet, etc.
connect.wcDesc: Tangem, MetaMask mobile, Rainbow — scan QR or approve in the app

security.intro: Your profile is tied to this wallet permanently. If you lose access to the wallet, the ID cannot be transferred or recovered. Read the following carefully.
security.li1t: Seed phrase wallets — back up before anything else
security.li1: Write the 12–24 words on paper. Verify word order when prompted. Store offline. Keep a second copy in a different location. Never store digitally — no photos, no cloud, no messaging apps.
security.li2t: Seed-less hardware wallets — get a backup device now
security.li2: The key lives only in the hardware chip. There is no seed phrase. Losing all copies of the device means permanent loss of access. Always have at least one backup device before registering.
security.li3t: Never share your key or seed phrase with anyone
security.li3: No legitimate service or support team will ever ask for it. Ransomware and phishing specifically target seed phrases.
security.li4t: If you lose wallet access — your passports are safe
security.li4: All passports you created remain valid and checkable forever. You only lose the ability to create new passports under that identity.
security.checkbox: I have backed up my key and understand the risks. My seed phrase is on paper / I have a backup hardware device.

register.warn: ⚠ Your type prefix cannot be changed after registration. One profile per wallet. Permanent.
register.btn: Register — only a small network fee (~US$0.01 typical)

type.Bd: Company, studio, label, collective (museums/collections use M)
type.Pd: Expert, auction house, certification — attestations on passports
type.Md: Collection or museum: unlimited passports for holdings (e.g. works by deceased artists)

typeInfo.C: Individual creator — artist, photographer, maker, or craftsperson. Use this if you are registering as a person.
typeInfo.B: Brand or collective — company, studio, label, or group. Use this for organizations; museums/collections should use M.
typeInfo.P: Proof institution — expert, auction house, or certification body. P-type accounts can attach confirmations to any passport.
typeInfo.M: Museum or collection — create passports for objects you hold in institutional custody (no monthly cap like smaller tiers). Use this for museums digitizing collections; you can attach confirmations like P-type institutions.

errors.connectInProgress: Connection already in progress. Approve or reject the request in your wallet extension (icon in the toolbar), then try again.
errors.walletPending: A wallet request is already open. Use the wallet extension icon in your browser toolbar to approve or cancel — do not click Connect again until that finishes.

noWallet.line1: No wallet found in this browser. On a computer, install
noWallet.line2: or another supported extension, then reload this page.
noWallet.mmHint: iPhone / Safari: there is no extension — MetaMask runs as an app with a built-in browser. This link opens the same page there so Connect works.
noWallet.fileProto: You opened this page as a local file — many wallets don’t work that way. Run a simple local web server for the web folder or use HTTPS hosting.
noWallet.httpsHint: Use https:// or http://localhost if the wallet still does not appear.
noWallet.wcLead: Or connect a phone wallet (e.g. Tangem) via WalletConnect — no browser extension required.

already.shareCaption: Open Share to download the profile card as PNG or send it from your device.
already.pl1: On your official website — prominently, not hidden in menus
already.pl2: In all your social media profiles and bios
already.pl3: On physical objects, packaging, and certificates you issue
already.pl4: In press releases and official communications

passportHelp.cardTitle: Passport already in the registry — what next
passportHelp.lead: On the Passport page you work with records that are already saved publicly. In short:
passportHelp.li1: Enter the passport number (ODP-…) and tap “Load from registry.”
passportHelp.li2: “Your passports” only lists items you created from this wallet. If someone transferred a passport to you, it won’t appear there — paste the number manually in that section.
passportHelp.li3: The registry has one administrative wallet for rules (often a shared organisation wallet). There is no built-in “many signers” panel inside the code itself.

share.title: Export profile
share.exportLead: Save the full profile card as an image — title, ID, badge, and QR — for posts, prints, or archives.
share.sharePreviewAlt: Card preview — same image as download
share.sharePngLibMissing: Image export library failed to load. Refresh the page and try again.
share.sharePngFail: Could not build the profile card image.
share.sharePngFallbackDl: This browser cannot share image files; the PNG was downloaded instead.

creator.qrFail: QR code library did not load (network or blocker).

docAttest.cardTitle: Stamp a document (PDF, etc.) in the registry
docAttest.body: Upload a file (for example a contract PDF). The page builds a fingerprint of the file on your device and only that fingerprint is saved in the public registry — you pay a small network fee. Others can fingerprint their copy and check it on Verify. This is not a full legal e-signature; it shows that this wallet recorded this file at a point in time.
docAttest.uriLabel: Optional public link to the same file (HTTPS)

pAff.body: Large organisations often have units. Each unit can register its own P profile and use its own wallet — the public record still shows who created what. In two short steps, a child P can be linked to a parent P so outsiders see they belong together while units stay independent.
pAff.cancelHint: To withdraw a link request you sent, enter the same parent ID and cancel — only before the parent confirms.
pAff.cancelNoPending: There is no pending request to this parent from your profile.
pAff.parentRequired: Enter a parent profile ID first.
pAff.proposed: Proposed. Waiting for parent to confirm.
pAff.childRequired: Enter a child profile ID first.
pAff.noPending: No pending request for this child under your parent link.
